== Course of events ==

After the Cowardly Lion kills the monster that had terrorized the forest, breaking its neck with a single blow, the beasts of the forest gather before him. In recognition of this deed, they bow to the Cowardly Lion, acknowledging him as King. The Cowardly Lion accepts this position among the beasts, but he does not remain to take up his rule at once. Instead, he tells the assembled beasts that he will return and rule over them, but only once Dorothy is safely on her way to Kansas. In this way, the Cowardly Lion sets his own loyalty to Dorothy above his new authority, delaying his kingship in the forest until her journey home is assured.
